specifications.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.ReportedSettling
specifications.statement: Lungo.Spec.Contract (Datacartridge.Forecast.Window × Bool × List Bool × Bool) Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome
specifications.definition:
{ pre := fun x => True,
  post := fun input o =>
    match input with
    | (window, due, observed, contested) =>
      (window = Datacartridge.Forecast.Window.atDeadline ∧ due = true ∧ contested = true →
          o = Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.void) ∧
        (¬(window = Datacartridge.Forecast.Window.atDeadline ∧ due = true ∧ contested = true) →
          Datacartridge.Forecast.Settling.post (window, due, observed) o) }

specifications.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.Settling
specifications.definition:
{ pre := fun x => True,
  post := fun input o =>
    match input with
    | (window, due, observed) =>
      (o = Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.open ↔
          due = false ∧ (window = Datacartridge.Forecast.Window.atDeadline ∨ observed.any id = false)) ∧
        (window = Datacartridge.Forecast.Window.anyTime →
            (o = Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.cameTrue ↔ observed.any id = true)) ∧
          (window = Datacartridge.Forecast.Window.atDeadline →
              due = true →
                (o = Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.cameTrue ↔ observed.getLast? = some true) ∧
                  (o = Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.didNot ↔ observed.getLast? = some false)) ∧
            (o = Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.void ↔ due = true ∧ observed = []) }

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.Clash.ofNat_reads_back
claims.statement: ∀ (c : Datacartridge.Forecast.Clash), Datacartridge.Forecast.Clash.ofNat c.ctorIdx = c

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.Hearing.ofNat_reads_back
claims.statement: ∀ (h : Datacartridge.Forecast.Hearing), Datacartridge.Forecast.Hearing.ofNat h.ctorIdx = h

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.Leave.ofNat_reads_back
claims.statement: ∀ (l : Datacartridge.Forecast.Leave), Datacartridge.Forecast.Leave.ofNat l.ctorIdx = l

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.ofNat_reads_back
claims.statement: ∀ (o : Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome), Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.ofNat o.ctorIdx = o

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.Sureness.ofNat_reads_back
claims.statement: ∀ (s : Datacartridge.Forecast.Sureness), Datacartridge.Forecast.Sureness.ofNat s.ctorIdx = s

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.Trend.ofNat_reads_back
claims.statement: ∀ (t : Datacartridge.Forecast.Trend), Datacartridge.Forecast.Trend.ofNat t.ctorIdx = t

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.Window.ofNat_reads_back
claims.statement: ∀ (w : Datacartridge.Forecast.Window), Datacartridge.Forecast.Window.ofNat w.ctorIdx = w

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.across_only_at_endings
claims.statement:
∀ (link : Datacartridge.Forecast.Link) (a b : Datacartridge.Forecast.Claim) (wa wb : Datacartridge.Forecast.When),
  wa.anyTime = true ∨ wb.anyTime = true → Datacartridge.Forecast.tooLikelyAcross link a b wa wb = false

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.agreed_is_settled_as_usual
claims.statement:
∀ (window : Datacartridge.Forecast.Window) (due : Bool) (observed : List Bool),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.settleReported window due observed false = Datacartridge.Forecast.settle window due observed

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.agreeing_exclusive_within_certainty
claims.statement:
∀ (a b : Datacartridge.Forecast.Claim),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.clash a b = Datacartridge.Forecast.Clash.agree →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.Claim.excludes✝ a b = true →
      Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood a.bps + Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood b.bps ≤ 10000

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.agreeing_respects_implication
claims.statement:
∀ (a b : Datacartridge.Forecast.Claim),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.clash a b = Datacartridge.Forecast.Clash.agree →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.Claim.implies✝ a b = true →
      Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood a.bps ≤ Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood b.bps

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.all_of_one
claims.statement: ∀ (o : Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome), Datacartridge.Forecast.all [o] = o

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.all_refuted
claims.statement:
∀ (parts : List Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.didNot ∈ parts →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.all parts = Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.didNot

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.all_settles
claims.statement:
∀ (parts : List Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome),
  (∀ (o : Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome), o ∈ parts → Datacartridge.Forecast.settled o = true) →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.settled (Datacartridge.Forecast.all parts) = true

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.always_right_reads_no_lower
claims.statement:
∀ (statedBps scored countsAs : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood statedBps ≤ Datacartridge.Forecast.recalibrated statedBps scored scored countsAs

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.any_confirmed
claims.statement:
∀ (parts : List Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.cameTrue ∈ parts →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.any parts = Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.cameTrue

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.any_of_one
claims.statement: ∀ (o : Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome), Datacartridge.Forecast.any [o] = o

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.any_settles
claims.statement:
∀ (parts : List Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome),
  (∀ (o : Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome), o ∈ parts → Datacartridge.Forecast.settled o = true) →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.settled (Datacartridge.Forecast.any parts) = true

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.any_time_is_not_undone_by_a_later_dispute
claims.statement:
∀ (due contested : Bool) (observed : List Bool),
  observed.any id = true →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.settleReported Datacartridge.Forecast.Window.anyTime due observed contested =
      Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.cameTrue

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.any_time_settles_early
claims.statement:
∀ (due : Bool) (observed : List Bool),
  observed.any id = true →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.settle Datacartridge.Forecast.Window.anyTime due observed =
      Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.cameTrue

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.any_time_stays_true
claims.statement:
∀ (due due' : Bool) (observed later : List Bool),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.settle Datacartridge.Forecast.Window.anyTime due observed =
      Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.cameTrue →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.settle Datacartridge.Forecast.Window.anyTime due' (observed ++ later) =
      Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.cameTrue

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.apart_either_way
claims.statement:
∀ (n₁ s₁ q₁ n₂ s₂ q₂ : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.apartBeyondChance n₁ s₁ q₁ n₂ s₂ q₂ =
    Datacartridge.Forecast.apartBeyondChance n₂ s₂ q₂ n₁ s₁ q₁

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.as_forecast_is_a_likelihood
claims.statement: ∀ (rateBps : Nat), 100 ≤ Datacartridge.Forecast.asForecast rateBps ∧ Datacartridge.Forecast.asForecast rateBps ≤ 9900

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.as_said_leans_neither_way
claims.statement:
∀ (forecasts came spread : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.provenAt ≤ forecasts →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.surenessOf forecasts came (came * 10000) spread = Datacartridge.Forecast.Sureness.about

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.ask_next_is_ahead
claims.statement: ∀ (now next every : Nat), 0 < every → now < Datacartridge.Forecast.askNext now next every

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.ask_next_keeps_time
claims.statement: ∀ (now next every : Nat), next ≤ now → (Datacartridge.Forecast.askNext now next every - next) % every = 0

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.ask_next_on_time
claims.statement: ∀ (next every : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.askNext next next every = next + every

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.asked_is_not_reported
claims.statement:
∀ (reported : List (Int × Nat)) (perYear : Nat) (next : Int × Nat),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.askedOf reported perYear = some next →
    ∀ (q : Int × Nat), q ∈ reported → Datacartridge.Forecast.later q next = true

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.asked_means_due
claims.statement:
∀ (active answered : Bool) (now next : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.asks active answered now next = true → active = true ∧ answered = true ∧ next ≤ now

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.at_deadline_waits
claims.statement:
∀ (observed : List Bool),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.settle Datacartridge.Forecast.Window.atDeadline false observed =
    Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.open

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.back_add
claims.statement:
∀ (perYear m n : Nat) (p : Int × Nat),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.back perYear (m + n) p =
    Datacartridge.Forecast.back perYear n (Datacartridge.Forecast.back perYear m p)

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.back_within_the_year
claims.statement:
∀ (perYear k : Nat) (year : Int) (index : Nat),
  k < index → Datacartridge.Forecast.back perYear k (year, index) = (year, index - k)

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.backing_of_anyone
claims.statement:
∀ (believedBps baseBps : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.backing believedBps (some baseBps) Datacartridge.Forecast.evenWeight =
    ↑(Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood believedBps) - ↑(Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood baseBps)

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.backing_without_history
claims.statement:
∀ (believedBps weightBps : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.backing believedBps none weightBps =
    Datacartridge.Forecast.backing believedBps (some 5000) weightBps

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.base_rate_extremes
claims.statement:
∀ (windows : Nat),
  0 < windows →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.baseRate windows windows = some 10000 ∧ Datacartridge.Forecast.baseRate 0 windows = some 0

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.base_rate_is_bounded
claims.statement: ∀ (held windows r : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.baseRate held windows = some r → r ≤ 10000

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.best_of_fold_scores_no_worse
claims.statement:
∀ (rest : List Datacartridge.Forecast.Tried) (first : Datacartridge.Forecast.Tried),
  (List.foldl Datacartridge.Forecast.better first rest).meanBrier ≤ first.meanBrier ∧
    ∀ (t : Datacartridge.Forecast.Tried),
      t ∈ rest → (List.foldl Datacartridge.Forecast.better first rest).meanBrier ≤ t.meanBrier

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.better_counts_for_no_less
claims.statement:
∀ (scored better worse : Nat),
  better ≤ worse → Datacartridge.Forecast.weight scored worse ≤ Datacartridge.Forecast.weight scored better

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.better_is_lower
claims.statement:
∀ (d b scoredDuring scoredBefore : Nat),
  (Datacartridge.Forecast.trend (some d) (some b) scoredDuring scoredBefore = Datacartridge.Forecast.Trend.better →
      d < b) ∧
    (Datacartridge.Forecast.trend (some d) (some b) scoredDuring scoredBefore = Datacartridge.Forecast.Trend.worse →
      b < d)

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.better_scores_no_worse
claims.statement:
∀ (a b : Datacartridge.Forecast.Tried),
  (Datacartridge.Forecast.better a b).meanBrier ≤ a.meanBrier ∧
    (Datacartridge.Forecast.better a b).meanBrier ≤ b.meanBrier

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.brier_is_bounded
claims.statement: ∀ (statedBps : Nat) (cameTrue : Bool), Datacartridge.Forecast.brier statedBps cameTrue ≤ 10000

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.brier_of_certainty
claims.statement:
Datacartridge.Forecast.brier 10000 true = 0 ∧
  Datacartridge.Forecast.brier 10000 false = 10000 ∧
    Datacartridge.Forecast.brier 0 false = 0 ∧ Datacartridge.Forecast.brier 0 true = 10000

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.brier_of_even_odds
claims.statement: ∀ (cameTrue : Bool), Datacartridge.Forecast.brier 5000 cameTrue = 2500

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.brier_rewards_being_right
claims.statement: ∀ (p q : Nat), p ≤ q → Datacartridge.Forecast.brier q true ≤ Datacartridge.Forecast.brier p true

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.calibrated_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (s : Datacartridge.Forecast.Split), Datacartridge.Forecast.calibrated s = true ↔ s.offBy ≤ 100

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.carried_holds
claims.statement:
∀ (link : Datacartridge.Forecast.Link) (a c : Datacartridge.Forecast.Claim) (x y : Int),
  link.binds x y → Datacartridge.Forecast.carried link a = some c → a.holdsOf x → c.holdsOf y

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.chosen_scores_no_worse
claims.statement:
∀ (forecasts : Nat) (tried : List Datacartridge.Forecast.Tried) (best : Datacartridge.Forecast.Tried),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.bestReading forecasts tried = some best →
    ∀ (t : Datacartridge.Forecast.Tried), t ∈ tried → best.meanBrier ≤ t.meanBrier

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.clashWhen_at_one_moment
claims.statement:
∀ (a b : Datacartridge.Forecast.Claim) (since₁ since₂ till : Int),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.clashWhen a b { anyTime := false, since := since₁, till := till }
      { anyTime := false, since := since₂, till := till } =
    Datacartridge.Forecast.clash a b

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.clash_with_itself
claims.statement: ∀ (a : Datacartridge.Forecast.Claim), Datacartridge.Forecast.clash a a = Datacartridge.Forecast.Clash.agree

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.conditional_is_not_refuted_by_its_condition
claims.statement:
∀ (consequence : Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.conditional Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.didNot consequence =
    Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.void

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.contested_at_the_deadline_is_void
claims.statement:
∀ (observed : List Bool),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.settleReported Datacartridge.Forecast.Window.atDeadline true observed true =
    Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.void

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.conviction_is_symmetric_and_bounded
claims.statement:
∀ (backingBps : Int),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.conviction (-backingBps) = Datacartridge.Forecast.conviction backingBps ∧
    Datacartridge.Forecast.conviction backingBps ≤ 10000

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.counting_for_nothing_reads_the_record
claims.statement:
∀ (statedBps came scored : Nat),
  0 < scored → Datacartridge.Forecast.recalibrated statedBps came scored 0 = min came scored * 10000 / scored

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.counts_any_time
claims.statement:
∀ (w : Datacartridge.Forecast.When),
  w.anyTime = true → ∀ (moment : Int), w.counts moment = true ↔ w.since < moment ∧ moment ≤ w.till

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.counts_at_the_deadline
claims.statement: ∀ (w : Datacartridge.Forecast.When), w.anyTime = false → ∀ (moment : Int), w.counts moment = true ↔ moment = w.till

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.discerning_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Datacartridge.Forecast.Split),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.discerning s = true ↔ 0 < s.howHard ∧ s.howHard ≤ 4 * s.toldApart

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.due_is_settled
claims.statement:
∀ (window : Datacartridge.Forecast.Window) (observed : List Bool),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.settled (Datacartridge.Forecast.settle window true observed) = true

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.even_odds_counts_as_anyone
claims.statement: ∀ (scored : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.weight scored 2500 = Datacartridge.Forecast.evenWeight

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.even_odds_expect_only_costs
claims.statement: ∀ (sizeBps costBps : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.expected 5000 (↑sizeBps) (-↑sizeBps) costBps = -(2 * ↑costBps)

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.expectedFirst_irreflexive
claims.statement: ∀ (a : Option Int × Int), Datacartridge.Forecast.expectedFirst a a = false

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.expected_at_the_extremes
claims.statement:
∀ (gainBps lossBps : Int) (costBps : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.expected 10000 gainBps lossBps costBps = gainBps - 2 * ↑costBps ∧
    Datacartridge.Forecast.expected 0 gainBps lossBps costBps = lossBps - 2 * ↑costBps

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.few_are_never_apart
claims.statement:
∀ (n₁ s₁ q₁ n₂ s₂ q₂ : Nat),
  n₁ < Datacartridge.Forecast.provenAt ∨ n₂ < Datacartridge.Forecast.provenAt →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.apartBeyondChance n₁ s₁ q₁ n₂ s₂ q₂ = false

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.few_calls_tell_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (forecasts came statedSum spread : Nat),
  forecasts < Datacartridge.Forecast.provenAt →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.surenessOf forecasts came statedSum spread = Datacartridge.Forecast.Sureness.untold

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.few_forecasts_tell_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (during before : Option Nat) (scoredDuring scoredBefore : Nat),
  scoredDuring < Datacartridge.Forecast.provenAt ∨ scoredBefore < Datacartridge.Forecast.provenAt →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.trend during before scoredDuring scoredBefore = Datacartridge.Forecast.Trend.untold

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.few_pairs_are_never_apart
claims.statement:
∀ (n : Nat) (d : Int) (q : Nat),
  n < Datacartridge.Forecast.provenAt → Datacartridge.Forecast.pairedBeyondChance n d q = false

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.group_split
claims.statement: ∀ (g : Datacartridge.Forecast.Group), ↑g.calls * g.squares = g.gap + 100000000 * (↑g.came * (↑g.calls - ↑g.came))

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.happening_apart_agrees
claims.statement:
∀ (p q : Nat) (a b : Datacartridge.Forecast.When),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.clashHappening false false p q a b = Datacartridge.Forecast.Clash.agree

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.happening_as_likely_agrees
claims.statement:
∀ (firstWithin secondWithin : Bool) (p : Nat) (a b : Datacartridge.Forecast.When),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.clashHappening firstWithin secondWithin p p a b = Datacartridge.Forecast.Clash.agree

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.happening_first_too_likely
claims.statement:
∀ (firstWithin secondWithin : Bool) (p q : Nat) (a b : Datacartridge.Forecast.When),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.clashHappening firstWithin secondWithin p q a b = Datacartridge.Forecast.Clash.firstTooLikely →
    firstWithin = true ∧
      b.since ≤ a.since ∧ a.till ≤ b.till ∧ Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood q < Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood p

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.happening_only_implies
claims.statement:
∀ (firstWithin secondWithin : Bool) (p q : Nat) (a b : Datacartridge.Forecast.When),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.clashHappening firstWithin secondWithin p q a b ≠ Datacartridge.Forecast.Clash.tooMuch ∧
    Datacartridge.Forecast.clashHappening firstWithin secondWithin p q a b ≠ Datacartridge.Forecast.Clash.tooLittle

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.lastWeek_is_whole_and_over
claims.statement:
∀ (today : Nat),
  13 ≤ today →
    (Datacartridge.Forecast.lastWeek today).snd = (Datacartridge.Forecast.lastWeek today).fst + 7 ∧
      (Datacartridge.Forecast.lastWeek today).snd ≤ today

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.latest_is_latest
claims.statement:
∀ (ps : List (Int × Nat)) (p q : Int × Nat),
  q ∈ p :: ps → Datacartridge.Forecast.noLater q (List.foldl Datacartridge.Forecast.laterOf p ps)

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.least_from_parts_only_when_carried
claims.statement:
∀ (parts : List Datacartridge.Forecast.Claim) (others : Int) (whole : Datacartridge.Forecast.Claim),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.leastFromParts parts others whole =
    if Datacartridge.Forecast.partsCarry parts others whole = true then
      some (Datacartridge.Forecast.leastWhenAll (List.map (fun x => x.bps) parts))
    else none

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.least_is_under_each
claims.statement: ∀ (bps : List Nat) (b : Nat), b ∈ bps → Datacartridge.Forecast.leastWhenAll bps ≤ ↑(Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood b)

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.least_of_one
claims.statement: ∀ (b : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.leastWhenAll [b] = ↑(Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood b)

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.life_of_one
claims.statement:
∀ (statedBps duration : Nat) (cameTrue : Bool),
  0 < duration →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.lifeBrier [{ statedBps := statedBps, duration := duration }] cameTrue =
      some (Datacartridge.Forecast.brier statedBps cameTrue)

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.mean_of_nothing
claims.statement: Datacartridge.Forecast.mean [] = none

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.mean_of_one
claims.statement: ∀ (s : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.mean [s] = some s

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.never_right_reads_no_higher
claims.statement:
∀ (statedBps scored countsAs : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.recalibrated statedBps 0 scored countsAs ≤ Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood statedBps

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.next_is_later
claims.statement:
∀ (year : Int) (index perYear : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.later (year, index) (Datacartridge.Forecast.nextPeriod year index perYear) = true

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.next_of_previous
claims.statement:
∀ (year : Int) (index perYear : Nat),
  1 ≤ index →
    index ≤ perYear →
      Datacartridge.Forecast.nextPeriod (Datacartridge.Forecast.previousPeriod year index perYear).fst
          (Datacartridge.Forecast.previousPeriod year index perYear).snd perYear =
        (year, index)

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.noLater_laterOf_left
claims.statement: ∀ (a b : Int × Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.noLater a (Datacartridge.Forecast.laterOf a b)

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.noLater_laterOf_right
claims.statement: ∀ (a b : Int × Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.noLater b (Datacartridge.Forecast.laterOf a b)

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.no_backing_no_conviction
claims.statement: Datacartridge.Forecast.conviction 0 = 0

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.no_backing_without_a_difference
claims.statement: ∀ (bps weightBps : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.backing bps (some bps) weightBps = 0

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.no_change_is_not_a_change_of_mind
claims.statement: ∀ (standing : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.mayStateAgain standing standing false = false

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.no_difference_is_not_apart
claims.statement: ∀ (n q : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.pairedBeyondChance n 0 q = false

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.no_record_reads_as_said
claims.statement:
∀ (statedBps countsAs : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.recalibrated statedBps 0 0 countsAs = Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood statedBps

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.no_rule_stays
claims.statement:
∀ (returnBps : Int) (heldDays : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.leave returnBps none none heldDays none = Datacartridge.Forecast.Leave.stay

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.nothing_observed
claims.statement:
∀ (window : Datacartridge.Forecast.Window) (due : Bool),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.settle window due [] =
    if due = true then Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.void else Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.open

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.occurs_settles_at_the_deadline
claims.statement:
∀ (seen : Bool) (hearing : Datacartridge.Forecast.Hearing),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.settled (Datacartridge.Forecast.occurs true seen hearing) = true

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.occurs_stays_true
claims.statement:
∀ (due : Bool) (hearing : Datacartridge.Forecast.Hearing),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.occurs due true hearing = Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.cameTrue

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.one_way_or_the_other
claims.statement:
∀ (standing said : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.mayStateAgain standing said true = !Datacartridge.Forecast.mayStateAgain standing said false

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.only_meeting_covers
claims.statement:
∀ (a b : Datacartridge.Forecast.Claim) (wa wb : Datacartridge.Forecast.When),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.When.meet✝ wa wb = false →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.clashWhen a b wa wb ≠ Datacartridge.Forecast.Clash.tooLittle

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.only_together_excludes
claims.statement:
∀ (a b : Datacartridge.Forecast.Claim) (wa wb : Datacartridge.Forecast.When),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.When.together✝ wa wb = false →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.clashWhen a b wa wb ≠ Datacartridge.Forecast.Clash.tooMuch

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.opposite_says_the_rest
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Datacartridge.Forecast.Claim),
  c.opposite.up = !c.up ∧ c.opposite.level = c.level ∧ c.opposite.bps = 10000 - Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood c.bps

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.paired_either_way
claims.statement:
∀ (n : Nat) (d : Int) (q : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.pairedBeyondChance n (-d) q = Datacartridge.Forecast.pairedBeyondChance n d q

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.parts_carry_is_sound
claims.statement:
∀ (parts : List Datacartridge.Forecast.Claim) (others : Int) (whole : Datacartridge.Forecast.Claim) (xs : List Int)
  (y : Int),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.partsCarry parts others whole = true →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.allHold parts xs → xs.sum + others ≤ y → whole.holdsOf y

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.pool_is_bounded
claims.statement: ∀ (views : List Datacartridge.Forecast.View) (p : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.pool views = some p → p ≤ 10000

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.pool_of_agreement
claims.statement:
∀ (views : List Datacartridge.Forecast.View) (statedBps : Nat),
  (∀ (v : Datacartridge.Forecast.View), v ∈ views → Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood v.statedBps = statedBps) →
    0 < Datacartridge.Forecast.weights views → Datacartridge.Forecast.pool views = some statedBps

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.pool_of_one
claims.statement:
∀ (weightBps statedBps : Nat),
  0 < weightBps →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.pool [{ weightBps := weightBps, statedBps := statedBps }] =
      some (Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood statedBps)

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.previous_is_a_period
claims.statement:
∀ (year : Int) (index perYear : Nat),
  1 ≤ index →
    index ≤ perYear →
      1 ≤ (Datacartridge.Forecast.previousPeriod year index perYear).snd ∧
        (Datacartridge.Forecast.previousPeriod year index perYear).snd ≤ perYear

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.proven_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (scored : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.proven scored = true ↔ Datacartridge.Forecast.provenAt ≤ scored

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.recalibrated_is_a_likelihood
claims.statement: ∀ (statedBps came scored countsAs : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.recalibrated statedBps came scored countsAs ≤ 10000

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.said_before_unsaid
claims.statement:
∀ (x backing other : Int),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.expectedFirst (some x, backing) (none, other) = true ∧
    Datacartridge.Forecast.expectedFirst (none, other) (some x, backing) = false

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.settle_reported_satisfies
claims.statement:
Lungo.Spec.Satisfies
  (fun input => Datacartridge.Forecast.settleReported input.fst input.snd.fst input.snd.snd.fst input.snd.snd.snd)
  Datacartridge.Forecast.ReportedSettling

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.settle_satisfies_settling
claims.statement:
Lungo.Spec.Satisfies (fun input => Datacartridge.Forecast.settle input.fst input.snd.fst input.snd.snd)
  Datacartridge.Forecast.Settling

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.skill_is_bounded
claims.statement: ∀ (meanBrier : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.skill meanBrier ≤ 10000

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.split_of_none
claims.statement:
∀ (groups : List Datacartridge.Forecast.Group),
  (List.map (fun x => x.calls) groups).sum = 0 → Datacartridge.Forecast.split groups = none

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.still_standing_is_the_same
claims.statement: ∀ (standing : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.mayStateAgain standing standing true = true

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.stop_comes_first
claims.statement:
∀ (returnBps : Int) (stop : Nat) (targetBps : Option Nat) (heldDays : Nat) (maxDays : Option Nat),
  returnBps ≤ -↑stop →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.leave returnBps (some stop) targetBps heldDays maxDays = Datacartridge.Forecast.Leave.stop

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.sureness_too_high
claims.statement:
∀ (calls : List Datacartridge.Forecast.Call),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.sureness calls = Datacartridge.Forecast.Sureness.tooHigh →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.cameTrue✝ calls * 10000 < Datacartridge.Forecast.statedSum✝ calls

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.sureness_too_low
claims.statement:
∀ (calls : List Datacartridge.Forecast.Call),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.sureness calls = Datacartridge.Forecast.Sureness.tooLow →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.statedSum✝ calls < Datacartridge.Forecast.cameTrue✝ calls * 10000

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.telling_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (windows : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.telling windows = true ↔ Datacartridge.Forecast.tellingAt✝ ≤ windows

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.tenth_is_bounded
claims.statement: ∀ (statedBps : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.tenth statedBps ≤ 9

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.the_same_are_not_apart
claims.statement: Datacartridge.Forecast.apartBeyondChance 5 10000 20000000 5 10000 20000000 = false

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.too_few_choose_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (forecasts : Nat) (tried : List Datacartridge.Forecast.Tried),
  forecasts < Datacartridge.Forecast.choosesAt → Datacartridge.Forecast.bestReading forecasts tried = none

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.too_high_is_high
claims.statement:
∀ (forecasts came statedSum spread : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.surenessOf forecasts came statedSum spread = Datacartridge.Forecast.Sureness.tooHigh →
    came * 10000 < statedSum

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.too_likely_across_is_sound
claims.statement:
∀ (link : Datacartridge.Forecast.Link) (a b : Datacartridge.Forecast.Claim) (wa wb : Datacartridge.Forecast.When)
  (x y : Int),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.tooLikelyAcross link a b wa wb = true →
    link.binds x y →
      (a.holdsOf x → b.holdsOf y) ∧ Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood b.bps < Datacartridge.Forecast.likelihood a.bps

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.too_low_is_low
claims.statement:
∀ (forecasts came statedSum spread : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.surenessOf forecasts came statedSum spread = Datacartridge.Forecast.Sureness.tooLow →
    statedSum < came * 10000

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.unanswered_is_not_asked
claims.statement: ∀ (active : Bool) (now next : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.asks active false now next = false

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.unheard_silence_is_void
claims.statement: Datacartridge.Forecast.occurs true false Datacartridge.Forecast.Hearing.never = Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.void

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.unproven_counts_as_anyone
claims.statement:
∀ (scored meanBrier : Nat),
  scored < Datacartridge.Forecast.provenAt →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.weight scored meanBrier = Datacartridge.Forecast.evenWeight

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.weekStart_is_the_monday
claims.statement:
∀ (day : Nat),
  6 ≤ day →
    (Datacartridge.Forecast.weekStart day + 3) % 7 = 0 ∧
      Datacartridge.Forecast.weekStart day ≤ day ∧ day < Datacartridge.Forecast.weekStart day + 7

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.weight_is_bounded
claims.statement:
∀ (scored meanBrier : Nat),
  1000 ≤ Datacartridge.Forecast.weight scored meanBrier ∧ Datacartridge.Forecast.weight scored meanBrier ≤ 10000

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.weighted_is_bounded
claims.statement:
∀ (views : List Datacartridge.Forecast.View),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.weighted views ≤ 10000 * Datacartridge.Forecast.weights views

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.within_bounds_stays
claims.statement:
∀ (returnBps : Int) (stop target heldDays days : Nat),
  -↑stop < returnBps →
    returnBps < ↑target →
      heldDays < days →
        Datacartridge.Forecast.leave returnBps (some stop) (some target) heldDays (some days) =
          Datacartridge.Forecast.Leave.stay

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.worse_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (meanBrier : Nat), Datacartridge.Forecast.worse meanBrier = true ↔ Datacartridge.Forecast.brier 5000 true < meanBrier

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.wrong_only_where_it_could_be_heard
claims.statement:
∀ (due seen : Bool) (hearing : Datacartridge.Forecast.Hearing),
  Datacartridge.Forecast.occurs due seen hearing = Datacartridge.Forecast.Outcome.didNot →
    Datacartridge.Forecast.silenceCounts hearing = true

claims.name: Datacartridge.Forecast.year_before_is_a_year_of_periods_back
claims.statement:
∀ (year : Int) (index perYear : Nat),
  1 ≤ index →
    index ≤ perYear →
      Datacartridge.Forecast.back perYear perYear (year, index) = Datacartridge.Forecast.yearBefore year index

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.HeldUp.ofNat_reads_back
claims.statement: ∀ (h : Datacartridge.Hindcast.HeldUp), Datacartridge.Hindcast.HeldUp.ofNat h.ctorIdx = h

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.a_stretch_holds_something
claims.statement: 0 < Datacartridge.Hindcast.atLeastPerStretch

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.alike_rate_of_none_alike
claims.statement:
∀ (now : Int) (stretches : List (Int × Bool)),
  (∀ (s : Int × Bool), s ∈ stretches → Datacartridge.Hindcast.alike now s.fst = false) →
    Datacartridge.Hindcast.alikeRate now stretches = none

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.alike_symm
claims.statement: ∀ (a b : Int), Datacartridge.Hindcast.alike a b = Datacartridge.Hindcast.alike b a

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.all_history_speaks
claims.statement: ∀ (horizon : Nat), Datacartridge.Hindcast.speaks true none horizon = true

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.all_were_asked_in_the_shared_stretch
claims.statement:
∀ (others : List Int) (first : Int),
  first ≤ Datacartridge.Hindcast.sharedFromAll first others ∧
    ∀ (x : Int), x ∈ others → x ≤ Datacartridge.Hindcast.sharedFromAll first others

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.better_means_lower
claims.statement:
∀ (settled forward even : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Hindcast.heldUp settled forward even = Datacartridge.Hindcast.HeldUp.betterThanEven → forward < even

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.calls_better_is_strict
claims.statement: ∀ (x : Option Nat), Datacartridge.Hindcast.callsBetter x x = false

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.calls_better_one_way
claims.statement: ∀ (x y : Option Nat), Datacartridge.Hindcast.callsBetter x y = true → Datacartridge.Hindcast.callsBetter y x = false

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.chosen_did_best
claims.statement:
∀ (totals : List Nat) (i : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Hindcast.chosen totals = some i → ∃ t, totals[i]? = some t ∧ ∀ (x : Nat), x ∈ totals → t ≤ x

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.counted_when_both_were_asked
claims.statement:
∀ (first other madeAt : Int),
  Datacartridge.Hindcast.countsBeside (Datacartridge.Hindcast.sharedFrom first other) madeAt = true →
    first ≤ madeAt ∧ other ≤ madeAt

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.cut_in_order
claims.statement: ∀ (n k i j : Nat), i ≤ j → Datacartridge.Hindcast.cut n k i ≤ Datacartridge.Hindcast.cut n k j

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.cuts_cover
claims.statement: ∀ (n k : Nat), Datacartridge.Hindcast.cut n k 0 = 0 ∧ Datacartridge.Hindcast.cut n k (k + 1) = n

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.enough_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (moments stretches : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Hindcast.enough moments stretches = true ↔
    (stretches + 1) * Datacartridge.Hindcast.atLeastPerStretch ≤ moments

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.every_way_is_heard
claims.statement:
∀ (stated : List (Option Nat)) (said : List Nat),
  Datacartridge.Hindcast.moment stated = some said → said.length = stated.length

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.learned_was_settled
claims.statement:
∀ (madeAt horizon testStart : Int),
  Datacartridge.Hindcast.learnable madeAt horizon testStart = true → madeAt + horizon ≤ testStart

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.left_out_only_when_all_silent
claims.statement: ∀ (stated : List (Option Nat)), Datacartridge.Hindcast.moment stated = none ↔ stated.all Option.isNone = true

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.mean_of_nothing
claims.statement: Datacartridge.Hindcast.mean [] = none

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.most_triable_is_triable
claims.statement:
∀ (times : List Int) (horizon : Int) (k : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Hindcast.mostTriable times horizon = some k →
    Datacartridge.Hindcast.triable times horizon k = true ∧ 1 ≤ k

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.needed_grows_by_a_stretch
claims.statement:
∀ (stretches : Nat),
  Datacartridge.Hindcast.needed (stretches + 1) =
    Datacartridge.Hindcast.needed stretches + Datacartridge.Hindcast.atLeastPerStretch

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.not_too_soon
claims.statement:
∀ (active : Bool) (settled : Nat),
  settled < Datacartridge.Hindcast.settledToChooseAgain → Datacartridge.Hindcast.chooseAgain active settled = false

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.not_turned_while_too_soon
claims.statement:
∀ (before : Datacartridge.Hindcast.HeldUp),
  Datacartridge.Hindcast.turned before Datacartridge.Hindcast.HeldUp.tooSoon = false

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.not_when_stopped
claims.statement: ∀ (settled : Nat), Datacartridge.Hindcast.chooseAgain false settled = false

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.scored_goes_first
claims.statement: ∀ (a : Nat), Datacartridge.Hindcast.callsBetter (some a) none = true

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.shared_from_all_of_two
claims.statement:
∀ (first other : Int),
  Datacartridge.Hindcast.sharedFromAll first [other] = Datacartridge.Hindcast.sharedFrom first other

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.shared_from_either_side
claims.statement: ∀ (first other : Int), Datacartridge.Hindcast.sharedFrom first other = Datacartridge.Hindcast.sharedFrom other first

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.silent_says_even
claims.statement: Datacartridge.Hindcast.said none = 5000

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.spoken_is_kept
claims.statement: ∀ (n : Nat), Datacartridge.Hindcast.said (some n) = n

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.the_series_itself_speaks
claims.statement: ∀ (days : Option Nat) (horizon : Nat), Datacartridge.Hindcast.speaks false days horizon = true

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.too_short_a_count_is_silent
claims.statement: ∀ (d horizon : Nat), d ≤ horizon → Datacartridge.Hindcast.speaks true (some d) horizon = false

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.too_soon_to_tell
claims.statement:
∀ (settled forward even : Nat),
  settled < Datacartridge.Hindcast.settledToChooseAgain →
    Datacartridge.Hindcast.heldUp settled forward even = Datacartridge.Hindcast.HeldUp.tooSoon

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.total_of_nothing
claims.statement: Datacartridge.Hindcast.total [] = 0

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.total_of_one_more
claims.statement:
∀ (tried : List Datacartridge.Hindcast.Tried) (t : Datacartridge.Hindcast.Tried),
  Datacartridge.Hindcast.total (tried ++ [t]) =
    Datacartridge.Hindcast.total tried + Datacartridge.Forecast.brier t.statedBps t.cameTrue

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.turned_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (before after : Datacartridge.Hindcast.HeldUp),
  Datacartridge.Hindcast.turned before after = true ↔
    before = Datacartridge.Hindcast.HeldUp.betterThanEven ∧ after = Datacartridge.Hindcast.HeldUp.noBetter

claims.name: Datacartridge.Hindcast.up_is_not_down
claims.statement: ∀ (a b : Int), 0 < a → b < 0 → Datacartridge.Hindcast.alike a b = false
